text:
mike: Deploybot flagged OOMs for redwood-quant-v2 in eu-west1 canary. Propose fastpatch: pin image v2.1.3-quant-fix + KV-cache bounds guard. Need expedited approval from releases + ml-infra + oncall.
priya: Confirmed on dashboards, 3/5 canary replicas OOM within 30m under long-request traffic.
kevin (ml-infra): Guard is small: cap per-request KV keys to 8, early-evict large prefixes. Ran staging with long sequences, 95th unchanged.
tess (oncall): Rollback criteria? I will watch but need clear thresholds.
mike: Rollback if 5xx > 0.8% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency > +200ms for 10m. Auto-fallback to redwood-quant-v2-legacy if deploybot marks degraded.
jordan: +1, keep canary at 5% for 10m then ramp if stable.
mike: Deploy command: deploybot release start --service=ml-serving --model=redwood-quant-v2 --image=redwood-quant:v2.1.3-quant-fix --env=eu-west1 --canary=5% --auto-rollback=false --meta="expedite:kv-guard"
releasebot: @mike created r-20260317-07.
deploybot: Canary 5% started in eu-west1.
tess: 10m at 5% completed — no 5xx spike, p95 +10ms, gpu mem steady. Recommend ramp to 30%.
jordan: ack ramp to 30%.
deploybot: Ramp to 30% -> then complete rollout.
kevin (ml-infra): Post-rollout sanity: OOMs reduced to baseline, p95 stable.
mike: Posted customer status and updated internal notes. Filed INFRA-1249 to add KV-bounds tests to CI.
priya: Closing thread from releases side.
